jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production modular environment atlas for the PipaKlub Brazilian kite-creature RPG. Image1 is SUBJECT/IDENTITY reference of our existing Quintal do Clube; image2 is ONLY modular orthographic game asset style. Clean 2D Japanese chibi RPG background pieces, warm dark outlines, crisp cel shaded color clusters, terracotta roof, pale warm plaster, teal wood, vivid tropical foliage accents. Slight elevated frontal 3/4 camera, consistent direction across all assets, no strong perspective vanishing point. REAL transparent alpha background, no colored background or vignette, no halo, no floor outside the actual object, NO people or creatures, no text, no letters, no grid marks. Landscape sheet with EXACTLY TWO equal columns and TWO equal rows, FOUR complete separate assets, each centered within its own cell, safe generous EMPTY transparent margins at least10% on each side. No object crosses cell borders. Wide pieces fit entirely. Top left: the club HOUSE FACADE WITHOUT ROOF, long single story pale cream plaster wall, teal door on left, open shaded wooden veranda with two slim posts, several colorful diamond kites neatly displayed on wooden racks, small potted plants, narrow stone front steps. NO roof: top edge clean and straight to receive separate roof. Top right: matching separate wide TERRACOTTA ROOF for that club facade, shallow pitched roof with curved orange-red clay tiles and wooden eave, simple chunky readable texture. Bottom left: OPEN GATE to Kronasta, two pale stone piers with spherical tops, open honey-brown wood double doors angled toward the sides leaving the CENTER COMPLETELY TRANSPARENT and wide enough to walk through, flowers only around side piers. NO background landscape seen through gateway. Bottom right: small MARKET STALL for kite lines, orange fabric canopy on four timber posts, counter showing blue yellow red thread spools and paper rolls, teal stool, few stacked wooden boxes. Fully isolated, no ground rectangle.
